aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab makes practical software for food trucks: online orders, pickup times and fewer repeated questions. The founder is Dominic Bonini.
aboutPage.meta.title: About us — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.build: We make practical software intended specifically for food trucks and mobile catering firms, helping them take online orders, manage pickup times, keep orders flowing smoothly and spend less time on questions that keep repeating.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab was created to change that.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: Yet much of the software available to them is made for firms with a fixed address.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our goal is simple: to make running a food truck easier, with tools designed around how these businesses really work.
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab came from a simple observation: food trucks need better tools to run their business.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After I made Village Foodie, a directory that helps people discover food trucks coming to their area, I spent more time getting to know the challenges mobile food businesses face. Unlike classic restaurants, food trucks are constantly on the move, work at different locations and serve customers in changing conditions.

comparison.faq.capacityA: Customers only see pickup times your kitchen can really meet. The system calculates from the preparation time of each dish and how many portions you prepare at once.
comparison.faq.capacityQ: How does the system prevent my kitchen being overloaded?
comparison.faq.costA: {plans}. Online card payments also carry Stripe fees: {cardFee} per card payment.
comparison.faq.costTrial: {months, plural, one {The first month is free} few {The first # months are free} other {The first # months are free}}, with all features.
comparison.faq.locationsA: Yes. You set up the weekly schedule with places and times, and customers order for the place and day when you are there.
comparison.faq.locationsQ: Does it work with changing locations?
comparison.faq.paymentsA: Customers pay online by card, with Apple Pay or Google Pay, or pay at pickup. PayPal and Klarna are not supported at the moment.
comparison.faq.paymentsQ: Which payment methods does HatchGrab support?
comparison.faq.termA: No. There is no minimum duration and no notice period. You can cancel any time; the fee is charged monthly in advance, and you keep access until the end of the paid month.
comparison.faq.termQ: Is there a minimum contract duration?
comparison.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
comparison.faq.tseA: HatchGrab is not a till and has no TSE. How you record online orders in your till is a question for your tax adviser.
comparison.faq.tseQ: Do I still need a till with a TSE?
comparison.faq.whatA: An ordering system takes orders online before customers reach the food truck: they choose dishes and a pickup time, pay online or on pickup, and the order appears in your kitchen. A till or card terminal takes payment at the food truck. The two complement each other.
comparison.faq.whatQ: What is an ordering system for food trucks?

featuresPage.detail.accountant_reports: Sales, tax and refunds for any month, quarter or tax year, ready to download and send to the accountant.
featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Let customers order for a future date or time before the event.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically — you do not have to confirm each one.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Add your logo to the QR code.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: Give an order a pager number when you hand one to the customer, so you know which pager belongs to which order.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen customers see, with order numbers and a notice when they are ready.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your food truck appears on the public HatchGrab map, so nearby customers can find you.
featuresPage.detail.documents_reminders: Keep certificates in one place, e.g. sanitary certificates, insurance and gas installation certificate. We will remind you before anything expires, and with one tap you can send them to an event or market organiser.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show upcoming dates on your site. Each one leads directly to its ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types, with special prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The fullest way to use HatchGrab: a live kitchen screen, and the only way to keep taking orders when you lose signal.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Set how much your kitchen can prepare at once and how long it takes. When a slot fills up, customers can no longer choose it.
featuresPage.detail.loyalty_stamp_cards: Reward regular customers with digital loyalty stamp cards — stamps are collected and redeemed automatically.
featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Combine items into combo deals and offer extras at checkout to raise the average order.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: Same as automatic replies on WhatsApp, but for enquiries on Messenger and Instagram.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Use several screens — at the counter and in the kitchen — all showing the same live orders.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give staff separate accounts with the right level of access.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: If you lose signal, online ordering pauses, so customers cannot send orders you will not see. The iPhone, iPad and Android app lets you take orders even without internet; the web dashboard needs a connection.
featuresPage.detail.online_payments: Take card payment upfront when customers order online, via Stripe.
featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set a deadline for items that need to be ordered earlier.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that do not show on the map, with their own private ordering link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.profit_per_event: Enter what each dish costs you and see what you really earned at every event, not just what the takings were.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A printable QR code that opens your menu and ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill in your schedule automatically — from your site or from a photo you already post on Facebook. You just review and confirm.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Automatically send customers an SMS when their order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your designs — we automatically add your dates, places and times for every week and every event.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark any item as sold out with one tap — customers immediately see it as unavailable.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Enter a stock quantity and it goes down as orders arrive, then the item is automatically marked sold out.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Take card payments on a supported phone, without a separate card terminal.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print order tickets on a Bluetooth or wired printer in the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose a pickup slot, so orders are spread across the whole service.
featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take and manage orders at the food truck, with payment on your own card terminal.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Manage your work from the browser on any phone, tablet or laptop.
featuresPage.detail.whatsapp_auto_replie: Automatically answer WhatsApp enquiries about your menu and schedule.

landing.does.capacityBody: Set how much you can prepare at once and how long it takes you. When a pickup slot fills up, customers can no longer choose it.
landing.does.devicesBody: Works on the phone in your apron, the tablet on the counter, the laptop in the food truck — and on the card terminal you already take payment on.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems assume a fixed address, reliable Wi-Fi and the same opening hours every week. You are somewhere new every week, at different times, with weak mobile signal or none. HatchGrab was made exactly for that.
landing.does.offlineBody: If you lose signal, online ordering pauses automatically, so customers cannot send orders you will not see. Keep taking orders in the app for iPhone, iPad and Android.
landing.does.postsBody: Upload the design you already post on Facebook or Instagram. We fill in your dates, places and times, ready for sharing — every week or every day.
landing.does.postsTitle: Automate your posts on Facebook and Instagram
landing.does.slotsBody: Customers order ahead and choose a pickup time. Shorter queues, and the food is ready when they arrive.
landing.does.title: Made for food trucks, not for restaurants.
landing.does.whatsappBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Your WhatsApp gets answers while you drive to the location or stand at the grill, based on your menu and schedule. Messenger and Instagram arriving soon.
